// An orientation-preserving isometry of space: converts to a rigid pose.
// Reflections are isometries but are NOT rigid here — they reverse
// orientation — and no scaling or shear qualifies.
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rigid_transformation
interface IRigid3D
    inherits IAffine3D
{
    Pose3D(x: Self): Pose3D;
}
